description: Figure 5 is a horizontal bar chart titled “Distribution of deceived conversations (%) across varying degrees of ambiguity,” which displays the number of conversations categorized by deception level for four distinct scenarios: Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism. Each scenario has three horizontal bars representing the count of conversations that were “Deceived” (red), “Partially” deceived (yellow), or “No” deception (green), as indicated by the legend. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Conversations” and ranges from 0 to 60. The chart shows that Academic Funding has the highest total number of conversations, with a large red bar indicating the “Deceived” category. Recruitment also has a significant number of “Deceived” conversations, while Academic Collaboration and Journalism show smaller counts, with Journalism having a noticeable yellow “Partially” deceived bar. The bars are grouped by scenario and ordered from top to bottom as Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism.
